It's popular among children and is easy to make.|Cooking (Interface)|AoC}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Hard-Boiled Eggs are [[Bird Egg]]s that have made contact with [[Hot Springwater]] from [[Hot Spring]]s. They are well-liked by children and easy to make. They can be eaten to restore one and a half [[Heart]]s. A [[Korok]] can be found inside [[Hyrule Castle (Dungeon)|Hyrule Castle]]'s [[West Passage]] by dropping a Bird Egg in the empty [[Offering Spot]] that is flanked by Hard-Boiled Eggs. ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} The [[Recipe]] for a Hard-Boiled Egg is obtained by completing the [[Scenario]] "[[Freeing Korok Forest]]". It is made using three [[Bird Egg]]s. Through the completion of the [[Quest]] "[[Hungry Hunches]]", however, the number of required Bird Eggs can be reduced to two. Preparing a Hard-Boiled Egg before a [[Challenge]] or [[Scenario]] increases the amount of experience gained by five percent. {{Noncanon|End}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== File:AoC Hard-Boiled Egg Icon.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}Hard-Boiled Egg icon ==See Also== {{See Also| * Campfire Egg * Food }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Eggs, Food, Health Restoring Items |items= BotW, TotK, AoC }}
